edits.new:
Then the package, the version and the rule ID on every answer are the values the local copy holds

  Scenario: AC8 The local decision record cannot be written, so the answer is not applied and nothing moves (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an evaluation is ready to be recorded and the local decision record write fails
    When RecordAndApplyActivity writes the record, the state change and the outbox row in one transaction
    Then the answer is not applied, nothing moves and no outbox row is written
    Then an incident is raised under R-UNI-39 and the failure is in the local run record
    Then the caller is shown MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC9 A caller without the Rules and parameters read right is refused at the edge and the local copy is unchanged (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller holds no Rules and parameters read right
    When the caller asks for the local copy or calls the model fetch
    Then the call is refused with MSG-P4-002 at the gateway-bff edge or by the rwb-decision contract
    Then the local copy of "ALLOC-2026.11" is unchanged

  Scenario: AC10 The scenario minimum and the cache size are read as parameters, so a changed value takes effect without a release (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns a changed value for rules.testcases.min and for drools.kiebase.cache.max on the parameters contract
    When rwb-integration loads the next version of "ALLOCATION"
    Then the local scenario set and the KieBase registry use the values the parameters contract returned
    Then no code change, no rebuild and no release of rwb-integration is needed
